proposed.label: Ignores the numerator of the exponent
proposed.description: Takes only the root named by the denominator and the reciprocal, and forgets to raise to the numerator: 64^(-2/3) is given as 1/4 (the value of 64^(-1/3)) instead of 1/16.

proposed.label: Drops the minus sign of the exponent
proposed.description: Evaluates the power as if the exponent were positive, so no reciprocal is taken: 64^(-2/3) is given as 16 instead of 1/16.

proposed.label: Reads a negative exponent as a negative answer
proposed.description: Treats the minus sign in the exponent as making the value negative: 64^(-2/3) is given as -16 instead of 1/16.
